razonamiento: The architecture shows National Australia Bank's (NAB) 'Deputy' automated compliance and deployment platform. Service teams run pipelines in their non-production account, sending build events to a Kong API Gateway hosted on Amazon ECS. ECS forwards the requests to AWS Lambda (annotated with x25 instances), which stores build event evidence in DynamoDB. For promotion/deployment, Lambda validates build records against compliance standards and controls stored in Amazon RDS PostgreSQL. Once validated, Lambda publishes promotion notifications via SNS to the target production account, and artifacts are copied from non-prod to prod.
